items.title: Ship
points: Auto win-back live, rate 9% or more
Manual sends 3 to 0.5 days a week

components.title: A written check-in every 30 days
components.text: What I did, where the numbers are, and what changes next

notes: My first 90 days come in three parts. Days 1 to 30, I listen: I visit 20 stores, interview 50 members, and get every team onto one member dashboard with the same definitions. The output is a top-ten list of member problems. Days 31 to 60, I decide: I pick two problems and turn them into specs. Right now I'd pick automatic win-back coupons and balance reminders. Both specs have to pass review. Days 61 to 90, I ship: automatic win-back goes live, with the win-back rate holding at 9% or better and manual sends cut from three person-days a week to half a day, and I hand in a draft roadmap for the next half. At the end of each 30 days, my manager gets a written check-in.
